meaning: All praise is due to Allah.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ
meaning: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His. Glory be to Allah, the Most Magnificent.

arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ
latin: Lā ilāha illā Anta yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm biraḥmatika astaghīth aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullahu
meaning: There is no god but You, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining. Through Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all my affairs for me.
